parsed.notes: Amendment No. 1 (Feb 26, 2026) raised the max Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio from 4.25x to 5.00x for March 31, 2026 through December 31, 2026, stepping down to 4.75x for March 31, 2027 through June 30, 2027. The 5.00x limit applies at 3/31/2026. The leverage-based pricing grid for the delayed draw term loan is excluded because it only sets the interest rate margin. Credit ratings are also excluded.
